notes: Pool of 20 defects in five groups of four. Each attempt activates two per group (see scenarios/larkspur/attempt.js). Every defect is off by default, and the page with no defects active is intended to pass WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA.

violations.title: Spanish review not marked as Spanish
violations.description: One review is written in Spanish, but nothing marks its language. Screen readers read it with English pronunciation rules, which makes it hard or impossible to understand.
violations.how_to_find: Listen to the reviews with a screen reader and note the pronunciation, or inspect the review markup for a lang attribute on the Spanish passage.
violations.fix: Add lang="es" to the element that wraps the Spanish heading and text.

violations.title: Specifications table has no header cells
violations.description: The specification labels (Volume, Weight and so on) are bold td cells instead of th elements. The table has no headers, so screen readers cannot announce which property each value belongs to when navigating by cell.
violations.how_to_find: Inspect the table markup, or navigate the table with screen reader table commands (Ctrl+Alt+arrows in NVDA, VO+arrows in VoiceOver) and listen for row headers.
violations.fix: Make the first cell of each row a <th scope="row">.

violations.title: Fixed-width layout forces horizontal scrolling
violations.description: The main content containers have a fixed width of 1120px. At 320 CSS pixels wide (or 400% zoom on a 1280px window), users must scroll horizontally to read every line, and parts of the header and product options are pushed off screen.
violations.how_to_find: Set the browser window to 1280px wide and zoom to 400%, or use a 320px-wide responsive viewport in DevTools, and look for a horizontal scrollbar.
violations.fix: Use a fluid width such as width: min(1120px, 100% - 2rem) so the layout reflows.

violations.title: Product highlights are clipped when text spacing is increased
violations.element: Product details, highlight chips (laptop sleeve, mesh back panel, side pockets)
violations.description: The highlight chips have fixed widths with overflow: hidden and no wrapping. When users increase letter and word spacing to the WCAG 1.4.12 values, the end of each phrase is cut off.
violations.how_to_find: Apply a text spacing bookmarklet or user stylesheet (line height 1.5, letter spacing 0.12em, word spacing 0.16em, paragraph spacing 2em) and check whether any chip text is cut off.
violations.fix: Remove the fixed widths and overflow: hidden, and let chip text wrap.

violations.title: Color swatches cannot be selected with the keyboard
violations.description: The color swatches are div elements with click handlers. They cannot receive keyboard focus and expose no role or selected state, so keyboard and screen reader users cannot choose a color.
violations.how_to_find: Tab through the product options: focus skips from the page to the size options without stopping on any color. Inspect a swatch to see it is a div.
violations.fix: Use a radio group (input type="radio" with visible labels) for the swatches, as for the size options.

violations.title: Size guide traps keyboard focus
violations.description: Opening the size guide moves focus into the dialog, then blocks Tab, Shift+Tab and Escape. The close control is a span that cannot receive focus, so keyboard users cannot leave the dialog without reloading the page.
violations.how_to_find: Open the size guide with the keyboard (Tab to Size guide, press Enter), then try Tab, Shift+Tab and Escape. Inspect the close control to see it is not a button.
violations.fix: Use a native modal dialog (dialog.showModal()) with a real <button> to close it, and let Escape close it.

violations.title: Cart dialog does not receive focus
violations.element: Header cart button and "Your cart" dialog
violations.description: The cart opens as a non-modal overlay and focus stays on the cart button. The dialog sits at the end of the DOM, so keyboard users must tab through the whole page to reach it, while the overlay covers the content they are tabbing through. Screen reader users are not told it opened.
violations.how_to_find: Tab to the Cart button and press Enter. Note where focus is, then keep pressing Tab and see how long it takes to reach the dialog's close button.
violations.fix: Open the cart with dialog.showModal() so focus moves into it and the rest of the page is inert, and return focus to the Cart button when it closes.

violations.title: Add to cart fires when the pointer is pressed
violations.description: The item is added on pointerdown, before the mouse button or finger is released. Users who press the wrong button by accident cannot cancel by moving the pointer away before releasing.
violations.how_to_find: Press and hold the mouse on Add to cart, drag off the button and release. The cart count still increases.
violations.fix: Trigger the action on click (the up-event), for example by relying on the form's submit event.

violations.title: Main product image has no text alternative
violations.description: The large product image has no alt attribute, and choosing a different view does not add one. Screen reader users get no description of the product's appearance, and some screen readers read the file name instead.
violations.how_to_find: Inspect the main image, or move through the gallery with a screen reader. axe flags this as image-alt.
violations.fix: Give the main image an alt that describes the current view, and update it when a thumbnail is chosen.

violations.title: Quantity buttons have no accessible names
violations.element: Quantity stepper, minus and plus buttons
violations.description: The decrease and increase buttons contain only SVG icons with no text or aria-label. Screen readers announce them as just "button".
violations.how_to_find: Tab to the quantity buttons with a screen reader running, or check each button's computed name in the DevTools Accessibility pane. axe flags this as button-name.
violations.fix: Add aria-label="Decrease quantity" and aria-label="Increase quantity", keeping the SVGs aria-hidden.

violations.title: "Added to cart" confirmation is not announced
violations.element: Message below the Add to cart button
violations.description: After adding an item, a confirmation appears and the header count changes, but neither is in a live region. Screen reader users hear nothing and may add the item several times.
violations.how_to_find: Add the item to the cart with a screen reader running and listen for any announcement. Inspect the message container for role="status" or aria-live.
violations.fix: Add role="status" to the message container.

violations.title: Add to cart button's accessible name does not match its label
violations.description: The button visibly reads "Add to cart" but has aria-label="Purchase item". Speech input users who say "click Add to cart" cannot activate it, and screen reader users hear a different name from the one sighted colleagues see.
violations.how_to_find: Compare the visible text with the computed accessible name in the DevTools Accessibility pane, or try activating it by its visible label with speech recognition software.
violations.fix: Remove the aria-label so the visible text is the name, or make the aria-label start with "Add to cart".

violations.title: Option groups have no group label
violations.description: The "Color" and "Size" headings are plain paragraphs, not fieldset legends. Screen reader users moving between options hear "Standard (28L), radio button" without being told which choice it belongs to.
violations.how_to_find: Inspect the option markup for fieldset and legend (or role="radiogroup" with a label). Tab into the size options with a screen reader and listen for the group name.
violations.fix: Wrap each group in a <fieldset> with a <legend> naming it ("Color", "Size").

violations.title: Inline link distinguished only by color
violations.description: The link in the product description has no underline and its color is barely different from the surrounding text (about 2:1). Users who cannot distinguish the colors do not know the text is a link.
violations.how_to_find: Look for links in body text without an underline. Measure the contrast between the link color and the surrounding text color (it must be at least 3:1 if color is the only cue). axe flags this as link-in-text-block.
violations.fix: Underline links in body text (or provide another non-color cue).

violations.title: Quantity buttons are too small
violations.element: Quantity stepper, minus and plus buttons
violations.description: The quantity buttons are 18 by 18 CSS pixels and sit directly against the quantity field. They are below the 24 by 24 minimum and too close to the field for the spacing exception, so users with tremors easily hit the wrong control.
violations.how_to_find: Measure the buttons in DevTools and check the gap between them and the input. axe flags this as target-size.
violations.fix: Make each button at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels (44 by 44 is better), or add enough space around them.

violations.title: Selected color is barely visible
violations.description: The ring that shows which color is selected is very light grey (#e1e5e3) on white, about 1.3:1. Low-vision users cannot tell which swatch is selected.
violations.how_to_find: Select a color and measure the selection ring against the white background with a contrast analyzer.
violations.fix: Use a selection ring with at least 3:1 contrast against the background, such as #1d2420.

violations.title: Stock message has insufficient contrast
violations.element: "In stock. Ships in 1–2 business days." message
violations.description: The stock message is light green (#6fbf73) on white, a contrast ratio of about 2.2:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum.
violations.how_to_find: Measure the text color against the background with a contrast analyzer. axe flags this as color-contrast.
violations.fix: Use a darker green such as #1f7a4a (about 5.4:1).

violations.title: Sale banner is an image of text
violations.element: Promotional banner at the top of the page
violations.description: The "Summer sale" banner is an SVG image containing text. Users cannot restyle it (font, spacing, colors), and it scales down to a few pixels high on small screens. The same message could be styled HTML text.
violations.how_to_find: Inspect the banner and note it is an img. Zoom text only (not the page) and notice the banner text does not grow, or view on a narrow screen.
violations.fix: Render the message as HTML text styled with CSS.

violations.title: Instructions rely on shape, location and color
violations.description: The instruction says "Choose a color from the round swatches on the right, then press the green button". Screen reader users, and users of the mobile layout where nothing is on the right, cannot identify the controls from shape, position and color.
violations.how_to_find: Read the instructional text and check whether it identifies controls only by shape, position or color.
violations.fix: Refer to controls by their labels: "Choose a color and a size, then select Add to cart."

violations.title: Ripstop tooltip cannot be dismissed or hovered
violations.element: Product details, "ripstop nylon" info button and tooltip
violations.description: Hovering or focusing the info button shows a tooltip over the content below. Escape does not dismiss it, and moving the pointer onto it makes it disappear, so magnifier users cannot read it and others cannot clear it without moving away.
violations.how_to_find: Hover the info icon, then try moving the pointer onto the tooltip. Focus the icon with the keyboard and press Escape.
violations.fix: Make the tooltip dismissible with Escape and hoverable (no gap, or keep it open while the pointer is over it), or use a click-to-open toggletip.
